_sagegui.name: Tryptic — high-res (go-to)
_sagegui.description: Michael Lazear's go-to for high-resolution instruments. Precursor window is DELTA MASS -1.25 to +3.5 Da, which in Sage's raw convention is written [-3.5, 1.25] (the raw pair is the delta range negated and reversed). The +3.5 delta side absorbs monoisotopic peak misassignment -- up to 3 13C, 3.01 Da -- which is why isotope_errors is left at Sage's (0,0) default. Fragment tolerance is +/-10 ppm here; use ~20 ppm for a typical Orbitrap MS2, ~100 ppm for TOF, ~1.0 Da for an ion trap.
